# choices

Display a group of connected buttons from which the user can select one option or, if `multiple` is `true`, several options. It works like a [`radio()`](/docs/version/latest/api-reference/interface-elements/radio) or [`checkboxes()`](/docs/version/latest/api-reference/interface-elements/checkboxes) group, displayed as a segmented control.

### Function Signature

```julia
function choices(
    label        ::String,
    options      ::Union{Vector, Tuple};
    id           ::Any                              =nothing,
    show_label   ::Bool                             =true,
    horizontal   ::Bool                             =true,
    multiple     ::Bool                             =false,
    allow_nothing::Bool                             =true,
    initial_value::Union{Vector, Tuple, AbstractString, Real, Nothing}    =nothing,
    onchange     ::Function                         =()->(),
    args         ::Vector                           =Vector()
)::Union{AbstractVector, Tuple, String, Number, Nothing}
```

| Argument        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|:--------------- |:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`         | A `String` to be displayed as the label for the group. It can contain HTML.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `options`       | A `Vector` or `Tuple` of selectable options. Each selectable option should be either a `String` or a `Real`, and will be displayed using its `String` representation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `id`            | An optional identifier for the widget. If provided, it is used to uniquely identify the widget so you can reference it in other functions, like [`get_value()`](/docs/version/latest/api-reference/interface-elements/get_value) and [`set_value()`](/docs/version/latest/api-reference/interface-elements/get_value#setvalue).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `show_label`    | A `Bool` indicating whether the label should be displayed. Default: `true`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `horizontal`    | A `Bool` indicating whether the options should be placed side by side (`true`) or stacked vertically (`false`). Default: `true`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `multiple`      | A `Bool` indicating whether the user can select more than one option. Default: `false`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `allow_nothing` | Only used when `multiple` is `false`. A `Bool` indicating whether the widget can have no option selected, in which case its value is `nothing`. If `true`, the user can click on the selected option to deselect it, and calling [`set_value()`](/docs/version/latest/api-reference/interface-elements/get_value#setvalue) with `nothing` deselects all options. If `false`, calling `set_value()` with `nothing` selects the first option in `options`. Default: `true`.                                                                                                       |
| `initial_value` | If `multiple` is `false`, the option that should be initially selected. If `multiple` is `true`, a `Vector`/`Tuple` of the options that should be initially selected. If `nothing` (default), the default value set with [`set_default_value()`](/docs/version/latest/api-reference/interface-elements/get_value#setdefaultvalue) will be used, if any. Otherwise, if `multiple` is `true`, no option will be selected; if `multiple` is `false`, no option will be selected if `allow_nothing` is `true`, and the first option in `options` will be selected if it is `false`. |
| `onchange`      | A callback `Function`. This function is called when the selection changes, before the app script is rerun.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `args`          | A `Vector` of arguments that will be passed to the `onchange` callback function.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

### Return Value

If `multiple` is `false`, the selected option, or `nothing` if no option is selected (only possible when `allow_nothing` is `true`). If `multiple` is `true`, a `Vector`/`Tuple` of the selected options.
